senses.definition_en: to dazzle, to blind temporarily

examples.english: […] taking a torch, he suddenly dazzled the adventurer and lit up part of the corridor.
examples.ref: 1834, José de Espronceda, “Chapter 17”, in Sancho Saldaña:
examples.text: […]sacando una linterna […], deslumbró de repente al aventurero e iluminó parte del corredor.
examples.translation: […] taking a torch, he suddenly dazzled the adventurer and lit up part of the corridor.

examples.ref: 2020, Stefano Vignaroli (original), translated by María Acosta Díaz, La sombra del campanile:
examples.text: El sol, ahora ya bajo en el horizonte, favorecía la maniobra del energúmeno deslumbrando la visión de los dos guardias, que estaban justo contra el sol con respecto a la escena que en poco tiempo terminaría.

glosses: to dazzle, to blind temporarily

senses.definition_en: to dazzle, amaze

examples.ref: 1993, Carmen Sanz Ayán, Sevilla y el comercio de Indias, page 44:
examples.text: Sus tiendas de lujo deslumbraron a los viajeros de la época

examples.english: At the age of 8 he was already appearing in the major German cities, and at 11 he dazzled the whole of Paris with his prodigal talent - the Parisians weren't easy customers to please - they were used to the explosive piano pieces of Liszt and Chopin, and the Mephistophelean fingerwork of Paganini
examples.ref: 2017 September 3, “Clara Wieck: una virtuosa de la música… y del amor”, in La Nacion:
examples.text: A los 8 años ya se presentaba en las principales ciudades alemanas y a los 11 deslumbró a todo París con su prodigioso talento: los parisinos no eran fáciles de impresionar: estaban acostumbrados a los fuegos de artificio pianísticos de Liszt y Chopin, y a la mefistofélica prestidigitación de Paganini.
examples.translation: At the age of 8 he was already appearing in the major German cities, and at 11 he dazzled the whole of Paris with his prodigal talent - the Parisians weren't easy customers to please - they were used to the explosive piano pieces of Liszt and Chopin, and the Mephistophelean fingerwork of Paganini

glosses: to dazzle, amaze
